author: carwow
description:
Hennessey has released an all-new Koenigsegg competitor - the Blackbird!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-0308

The Blackbird follows on from Hennessey’s first two hypercars, the Venom GT & Venom F5, and it’s been inspired by the legendary SR-71 Blackbird aircraft. 

The question is, what makes it a true Koenigsegg competitor? Let’s take a closer look… Starting with the engine! 

While the Venom GT & F5 were both powered by the same twin-turbo V8, Hennessey instead opted to fit the Blackbird with an all-new, 6.2-litre naturally-aspirated V8. This produces between 800 and 850hp, with all of this power sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual! 

What’s more, it revs to 9000RPM (the highest-revving naturally-aspirated V8 on any road car), can hit 60mph in 2.5 seconds (about the same as the CC850), and it has a top speed of 220mph!
